preconditions.description: Attacker must hold some JizzJet tokens to initiate the transfer
Contract must have accumulated enough tokens in its balance to trigger swapAndLiquify (>= numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity)

exploit_hint: The reentrancy vulnerability exists in the swapAndLiquify function which calls swapTokensForEth that uses swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens. This external call to the Uniswap router can be exploited if the attacker's contract receives ETH from the swap and re-enters the transfer function before state updates. Create a malicious contract that: 1. Holds JizzJet tokens, 2. Implements a fallback/receive function that calls transfer() again when receiving ETH, 3. Transfers tokens to trigger swapAndLiquify when contract balance is high enough, 4. Re-enters during the ETH transfer to manipulate balances before fees are properly accounted for.
